d:
Hazen Audel ventures into the dangerous tropical waters of Pongso No Tao in a traditional wooden boat, testing his endurance and survival skills in pursuit of a prized giant fish.
Survival expert Hazen Audel takes on the planet’s toughest environments, from dense jungles to frozen wildernesses, using traditional survival skills, courage and instinct to overcome nature’s most extreme challenges.
